five_second.sells: online art/creativity courses tied to a technique called Neurographica and a spiritual 'Art of Manifesting Method'
five_second.for_whom: people into art therapy, mindfulness, and manifestation/wellness practices

errand.abandoned_at: the 'Art of Manifesting Method Coaching Certification' course page showing $997-$1997 pricing, after exhausting the homepage course tiles and the full Courses/store list
errand.abandon_trigger: no course anywhere on the homepage, the hamburger nav, or the full Courses/store catalog was labeled 'NeuroGraphica', 'basics', or 'beginner' - the only prominent, top-listed course card turned out to be a $997-$1997 four-month coaching certification, a total mismatch for the entry-level course my friend described

features_used.moment: I tapped the big hero button hoping it would jump straight to course details, but it just scrolled me down to a course section on the same page.
I tapped the menu icon to find a direct 'courses' link; the first tap only scrolled the page and the menu didn't visibly open, so I had to tap it again before the nav list appeared.
I scrolled through every featured course card looking for a NeuroGraphica basics option and found six items, none named or described as NeuroGraphica or beginner.

features_used.feature: course detail page (AM Method Coaching Certification)
features_used.moment: I opened the top, most prominent course card hoping it was a starter option, and instead found a four-month professional certification priced from $997 to almost $2000.

features_looked_for_but_missing: a course literally named 'NeuroGraphica' or 'NeuroGraphica Basics/Beginner'
a 'start here' or skill-level label on the course catalog
a search bar to search for 'neurographica' directly
price or level sorting/filtering on the courses page
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: the Courses page listing every featured course in one scrollable list, at least letting me quickly rule out each one by name
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: the total absence of any course named or labeled 'NeuroGraphica basics/beginner' despite Neurographica being the site's own headline term, plus the top course card turning out to be a four-figure certification instead of an entry-level option

friction.moment: the hamburger menu needed two taps before it actually opened with the nav links
no item in the full course catalog matches the 'NeuroGraphica' branding used in the site's own hero text and page title
the only 'top' looking, most prominent course card was a $997-$1997 professional coaching certification, not a starter course

delight.moment: the homepage's calm, colorful hand-drawn artwork on landing felt inviting and matched the creative-wellness mood

what_earned_it: real, active-looking social links (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) suggesting a genuine small business
consistent personal branding around a named instructor (Anna Denning / Neuro Art School) rather than a generic template feel
trust.what_it_would_take: a clearly labeled 'NeuroGraphica for Beginners' course card on the homepage and courses page, with a normal starter price shown up front, so I'm not left guessing whether the $1000+ certification is the thing my friend recommended

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's a pretty New-Age-y art course site about something called Neurographica, but I hunted through the whole course list and never found the basic beginner course you meant - the closest thing I found was a $1000+ coaching certification.
brand_recall.product_remembered: Art of Manifesting Method Coaching Certification
